item.title: llama.cpp merges speculative decoding revamp
item.author: K. Ito
item.description: The llama.cpp project merged a reworked speculative decoding path, with maintainers reporting notable speedups when pairing small Qwen draft models with larger targets.

item.title: Day-one support: DeepSeek V4 Pro lands in vLLM and llama.cpp
item.author: K. Ito
item.description: Within hours of release, DeepSeek V4 Pro gained serving support in vLLM and a conversion path in llama.cpp, continuing the pattern of open runtimes tracking frontier releases at launch.

item.title: DeepSeek opens V4 Pro weights for research use
item.author: K. Ito
item.description: DeepSeek said researchers can request the V4 Pro checkpoints starting today. Early adopters are serving the release through vLLM at launch. Helios Labs said it will fine-tune the model for laboratory automation workloads.
